functions.name: RemoveConnection
functions.docs: Removes the filter status for ConnectionHandle. If it's a parent connection it will act as if all child connections were removed too and allow the instance to be used with a different ParentConnectionId.

functions.name: GetFilterStatus
functions.docs: Returns Disallowed if no connections with the supplied ParentConnectionId have set the filter status to Allowed. If at least one connection with the ParentConnectionId allows replication then Allowed is returned.
